item.title: Azure Landing Zones: Centralize the Guardrails, Not Every Decision
item.description: An Azure landing zone is sometimes presented as a collection of subscriptions, policies and management groups that you deploy before application teams arrive. That is technically true, but it undersells the problem. The real objective is to make it possible for many teams to use Azure independently without every team having to redesign identity, networking, security, governance and operations from zero. Why a landing zone appears With one subscription and one team, governance can be informal.
